capabilities: Create desktop shortcuts to a vault, file, or tag search
Create Windows Start Menu shortcuts for a vault
Discover known vaults via the Obsidian CLI for shortcut creation
Toggle Desktop, Start menu, and tag shortcut context-menu entries in settings
disambiguation: Not keyboard hotkeys; it writes OS shortcut files (.url or .desktop) that launch Obsidian.
extras: Not yet published as a release or directory submission; requires Obsidian desktop 1.13.7+ and, for vault discovery, the Obsidian CLI (installer 1.12.7+). macOS and Linux support are experimental and untested by the author; mobile is unsupported. Created shortcuts keep working after the plugin is disabled or uninstalled.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create operating-system shortcuts that jump directly to a specific vault, note, or tag search from the Desktop or Start Menu.
summary: Creates desktop and Windows Start Menu shortcut files that open a vault, note, or tag search in Obsidian via its URI handler.
